research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Apeel Sciences is researching edible coating compositions and barrier film compositions for agricultural products, as described in titles such as Edible coating compositions and Barrier film composition. Abstracts detail plant-derived coatings using monoglycerides, fatty acids, waxes, and lecithins to form protective barriers that extend shelf life. Additional work includes methods for preparing and preserving sanitized products and machine learning-based assessment of food item quality, highlighting focus on produce preservation and quality monitoring.
